integrity.computational_scope: Exact rational and integer tests cover finite parameters; the all-dimensional result rests on the written analytic proof.
integrity.historical_priority: Provisional, with identified primary literature and accessible full-text comparisons.
integrity.unproved_extrapolations: No other truncation paths, multiple cuts, or universal stability modulus are claimed.

scientific_limitations: Only one-vertex parallel truncations of finite-dimensional simplices are covered.
The cut parameter is 0<=t<1; the expression at t=1 denotes a one-sided full-dimensional limit.
The order-n contact at the simplex is family-specific and is not a global Banach-Mazur stability exponent.
Exact priority versus any unindexed older frustum-moment formulas remains provisional.
title: Sharp isotropic-constant profile and two endpoint contact orders for apex-truncated simplices
